ai.title: Invalid skills refusal names the rejected skill and field
ai.summary: Adds `invalidSkillsRefusal` to `common/src/desktop-cloud/project-settings.ts`, replacing the previous generic 400 response for rejected cloud skill payloads with a specific message identifying the offending skill, field, and Zod error code. The implementation handles Zod v4 union failures by selecting the branch with the fewest issues, ensuring encoding errors in base64 uploads are not misattributed to missing fields in the plain upload variant.
